description: Sarvam AI's Indus Cowork is launched for 2,500 Maharashtra officials, enhancing productivity with AI-driven administrative tools.
body_lead: Sarvam AI's Indus Cowork is being rolled out to 2,500 Maharashtra government officials following its launch by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on October 28. The AI productivity platform is designed to help officials draft documents, analyse reports, summarise files and search government records. The Maharashtra government approved the deployment of Sarvam’s sovereign AI solutions in August, with a two-year outlay of ₹11.26 crore. The agreement covers Indus Cowork for government employees alongside other AI and speech technology applications.
